title: PonsFamily v3 launch factory on Robinhood Chain
tagline: Every event of the PonsFamily v3 launch factory proxy since its deployment at block 121,605,721: token launches, launch configs and pair-token economics. Only this one contract is indexed.

queries.title: Latest launches
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, block_timestamp, token, deployer, "pairToken", "launchConfigId", "startTick" FROM pons_v2launch_factory__token_launched_instant ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Launches per deployer
queries.sql: SELECT deployer, count(*) AS launches, min(block_number) AS first_block, max(block_number) AS last_block FROM pons_v2launch_factory__token_launched_instant GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY launches DESC LIMIT 10

queries.title: Launch configs added
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM pons_v2launch_factory__launch_config_added ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Pair-token economics updates
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM pons_v2launch_factory__pair_token_economics_updated ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Ownership and upgrade events
queries.sql: SELECT 'ownership_transferred' AS event, count(*) AS n FROM pons_v2launch_factory__ownership_transferred UNION ALL SELECT 'upgraded', count(*) FROM pons_v2launch_factory__upgraded UNION ALL SELECT 'upgrade_proposed', count(*) FROM pons_v2launch_factory__upgrade_proposed

prompts: How many tokens has the factory launched, and what are the first and last launch blocks?
Show the latest 10 launches with token, deployer and pair token.
Which deployers launched more than one token?
List the launch configs that were added or updated, with their block numbers.
List every table in this nest with its row count, then say in two sentences what the data is good for.
